create_episode: create an Episode object and initialise it with an observation and info dictionary
add_step_to_episode: add a transition step with observation, reward, action, terminated, truncated, and info to an Episode
get_episode_data: get the stored episode data as a dictionary of numpy arrays from an Episode object
collect_episodes_batch: create a CollectEpisodes object to track multiple ongoing episodes across a batch of parallel environments
retrieve_completed_episodes: retrieve the list of completed episodes and their returns and lengths from a CollectEpisodes object
